name: SISTERPHILE
source:
When your beloved sister reveals her new girlfriend, it threatens the childhood promise you both swore to uphold. How far will you go to protect her… and keep that promise?

[From [url=https://maple0.itch.io/sisterphile]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当你心爱的妹妹透露了她的新女友时，你们俩发誓要遵守的儿时承诺就会受到威胁。为了保护她……并遵守诺言，你会付出多大的努力？

[来自[url=https://maple0.itch.io/sisterphile]itch.io[/url]]
